cobol_source:
**************************************************************** 
* PROGRAM NAME                 : LOGIN                         * 
* IMPORTANT FILE               : DB2 TABLE EMPLO, CRYPT FILE   * 
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                      * 
* DATE OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                    * 
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2            * 
**************************************************************** 
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        * 
*                                                              * 
*   RECEIVE USERID AND PASSWORD FROM USER VERIFY THE PASSWORD  * 
*         AND CHOSE THE CORRECT MAP TO CALL BY XCTL            * 
**************************************************************** 
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            * 
*                                                              * 
* USERID AND PASSWORD BY USER                                  * 
**************************************************************** 
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           * 
*                                                              * 
* CALL THE COMPATIBLE MAP WITH THE EMPLOYEE DEPARTMENT         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
**************************************************************** 
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                    * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. 
 PROGRAM-ID. LOGIN. 
                                                                 
**************************************************************** 
*                       DATA DIVISION.                         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 DATA DIVISION. 
                                                                 
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------* 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                      MAPS CICS COPY                          * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 COPY LOGINMP. 
 COPY DFHAID. 
 COPY DFHBMSCA. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                      SQL DECLARATION.                        * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         INCLUDE EMPLO 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         INCLUDE SQLCA 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                        WS VARIABLES                          * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 01  WS-TSTAMP                    PIC S9(15) COMP-3. 
                                                                  
 01  WS-DATE                      PIC X(10). 
 01  WS-TIME. 
     02 WS-HOUR                   PIC 9(2). 
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1). 
     02 WS-MINUTE                 PIC 9(2). 
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1). 
     02 WS-SECOND                 PIC 9(2). 
                                                                     
 01  WS-COMMAREA.                                                    
     02 TRANSACTION               PIC X(4).                          
     02 USER-ID                   PIC X(8).                          
                                                                     
 01  WS-USERID                    PIC X(8).                          
 01  WS-PASSWORD                  PIC X(8).                          
 01  WS-ADMIDATE                  PIC X(10).                         
 01  WS-FLAG-LS.                                                     
     02 WS-FLAG-RETURN            PIC X.                             
     02 WS-FLAG-ERROR             PIC X(10).                         
 01  WS-DEPT                      PIC S9(9) COMP.                    
                                                                     
 01  SUBPROGRAM                   PIC X(8).                          
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
*                    PROCEDURE DIVISION.                      *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 PROCEDURE DIVISION.                                                 
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
* MAIN-PARA.                                                  *      
*                                                             *      
* THIS PROGRAM WORKS WITH A PSEUDO-CONVERSATION METHOD.       *      
* THE MAIN PARAGRAPH SET THE PROCEDURE FLOW WHICH CONTROLS THE*      
* LOGIN MAP.                                                  *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 MAIN-PARA.                                                          
                                                                     
     IF EIBCALEN = 0                                                 
         MOVE '                 WELCOME TO COBOL AIRLINES SYSTEM'    
                                     TO MSG1O                        
         PERFORM 0100-GET-TIME                                       
         PERFORM 0110-GIVING-TIME                                    
         PERFORM 0200-SEND-MAP                                       
         PERFORM 0300-RETURN-CICS                                    
     ELSE                                                            
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG1O                                         
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG2O                                         
         PERFORM 0400-RECEIVE-MAP                                    
         PERFORM 0500-PROCESS-LOGIN                                  
         PERFORM 0100-GET-TIME                                       
         PERFORM 0110-GIVING-TIME                                    
         MOVE SPACE TO USERIDO                                       
         MOVE SPACE TO PASSWO                                        
         PERFORM 0200-SEND-MAP                                       
         PERFORM 0300-RETURN-CICS.                                   
     END-IF                                                          
                                                                     
***************************************************************      
* 0100-GET-TIME.                                              *      
*                                                             *      
* FOR GET THE TIME WE CAN UTILISE THE CICS METHOD OR THE COBOL*      
* METHOD IF THE FUNCTION CURRENT-TIME. BUT HERE WE CHOSE THE  *      
* THE CICS METHOD.                                            *      
***************************************************************      
                                                                     
 0100-GET-TIME.                                                      
                                                                     
     EXEC CICS                                                       
         ASKTIME                                                     
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                          
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                     
     EXEC CICS                                                       
         FORMATTIME                                                  
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                          
         DATESEP('/')                                                
         DDMMYYYY(WS-DATE)                                           
     END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                 
     EXEC CICS 
         FORMATTIME 
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP) 
         TIMESEP(':') 
         TIME(WS-TIME) 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                 
*************************************************************** 
* 0110-GIVING-TIME.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* AFTER GETTING THE TIME ITS NECESSARY TO TRANSFER THIS INFO  * 
* TO THE LOGIN MAP ITSELF                                     * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 0110-GIVING-TIME. 
                                                                 
     IF WS-HOUR = 23 
        MOVE ZEROS TO WS-HOUR 
     ELSE 
        ADD 1 TO WS-HOUR. 
     END-IF 
                                                                 
     MOVE WS-TIME TO LHOURO 
     MOVE WS-DATE TO LDATEO. 
                                                                 
*************************************************************** 
* 0200-SEND-MAP.                                              * 
*                                                             * 
* SEND MAP PROCEDURE IS IMPORTANTE TO CHANGE INFORMATIONS WITH* 
* THE USER AND IN THE PSEUDO CONVERSATION METHOD.             * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 0200-SEND-MAP. 
                                                                 
     EXEC CICS 
         SEND MAP('LOGON') MAPSET('LOGINMP') ERASE 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0300-RETURN-CICS.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* RETURN LETS THE PROGRAM FREE TO RECEIVE OTHER INFORMATIONS  * 
* FROM ANOTHER USERS.                                         * 
* THE COMMUNICATION-AREA IS USED TO SEND INFORMATION BETWEEN  * 
* MAPS.                                                       * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0300-RETURN-CICS. 
                                                                  
     EXEC CICS 
         RETURN TRANSID ('LOGP') 
         COMMAREA(TRANSACTION) 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0400-RECEIVE-MAP.                                           * 
*                                                             * 
* IT RECEIVES THE USER INFORMATION TO BE PROCESSED            * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0400-RECEIVE-MAP. 
                                                                  
     EXEC CICS 
         RECEIVE MAP('LOGON') MAPSET('LOGINMP') 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0500-PROCESS-LOGIN.                                         * 
*                                                             * 
* IN THE LOGIN MAP ITS NECESSARY TO VERIFY THE LOGIN AND THE  * 
* PASSWORD, IF THEY ARE CORRECT THE PROGRAM WILL VERIFY WHICH * 
* DEPARTMENT THE EMPLOYEE BELONGS TO SEND HIM TO THE CORRECT  * 
* MAP                                                         * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0500-PROCESS-LOGIN. 
                                                                  
     PERFORM 0510-GET-LOGIN. 
     PERFORM 0520-PROCESS-DATA. 
                                                                  
*************************************************************** 
* 0510-GET-LOGIN.                                             * 
*                                                             * 
* THIS PARAGRAPH GETS THE USERID AND THE PASSWORD AND VERIFY  * 
* IF THEY ARE CORRECT. FOR GET MORE INFORMATIONS ABOUT THE    * 
* CRYPTOGRAPHY METHOD GO TO THE CRYPTO PROGRAM CALL HERE.     * 
*************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0510-GET-LOGIN. 
                                                                  
     MOVE USERIDI TO WS-USERID 
     MOVE PASSWI TO WS-PASSWORD 
                                                                  
     EXEC SQL 
         SELECT ADMIDATE, DEPTID 
         INTO :WS-ADMIDATE, :WS-DEPT 
         FROM EMPLO 
         WHERE EMPID = :WS-USERID 
     END-EXEC. 
                                                                  
     EVALUATE SQLCODE 
        WHEN 0 
            MOVE 1 TO WS-FLAG-RETURN. 
            MOVE 'CRYPTVE' TO SUBPROGRAM 
            CALL SUBPROGRAM USING WS-PASSWORD, WS-USERID, WS-ADMID
                                               WS-FLAG-LS. 
        WHEN 100 
            MOVE 1 TO WS-FLAG-RETURN.                                  
        WHEN OTHER                                                     
            MOVE 2 TO WS-FLAG-RETURN.                                  
     ELSE                                                              
                                                                       
***************************************************************        
* 0520-PROCESS-DATA.                                          *        
*                                                             *        
* THIS PARAGRAPH ANALYSE THE WS-FLAG-RETURN. THE 0 MEANS      *        
* USERID AND PASSWORD ARE OK. 1 USERID OR PASSOWERD INVALID   *        
* 2 ANOTHER ERROR OCCURRED.                                   *        
***************************************************************        
                                                                       
 0520-PROCESS-DATA.                                                    
                                                                       
     EVALUATE WS-FLAG-RETURN                                           
        WHEN 0                                                         
            EVALUATE WS-DEPT                                           
               WHEN 1                                                  
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE CEO MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O      
               WHEN 2 OR 3 OR 4                                        
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE CREW MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O     
               WHEN 5                                                  
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE HR MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O       
               WHEN 6                                                  
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID                             
                   MOVE 'THE IT MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' TO MSG1O       
               WHEN 7                                                  
                   EXEC CICS XCTL                                      
                      PROGRAM('SRCHFLI')                               
                      COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                            
                      LENGTH(12)                                       
               WHEN 8 
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID 
                   MOVE 'THE LAWYER MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' 
                                                       TO MSG1O 
               WHEN 9 
                   MOVE USERIDI TO USER-ID 
                   MOVE 'THE SCHEDULE MAP IS NOT AVAIBLE YET' 
                                                       TO MSG1O 
            END-EVALUATE 
        WHEN 1 
            MOVE 'PASSWORD OR USERID INCORRECT.' TO MSG1O. 
        WHEN 2 
        MOVE 'COMMUNICATION ERROR IN THE SYSTEM CALL THE IT DEPT'
                                TO MSG1O 
            MOVE 'COMMUNICATE THE FOLLOW CODE ERROR: ' 
                                TO MSG2O 
            MOVE WS-FLAG-ERROR TO MSG2O(37:10) 
     END-EVALUATE.

plan.approach: The COBOL LOGIN program is a CICS pseudo-conversational transaction that (a) shows a welcome screen on first invocation, (b) receives user-id/password on subsequent invocations, (c) queries the EMPLO DB2 table, (d) calls the CRYPTVE sub-program for password verification, and (e) routes to the correct CICS map via XCTL based on DEPTID. The migration replaces the pseudo-conversational model with a stateless REST API (GET /api/login for welcome, POST /api/login for authentication), maps CICS-specific constructs to Spring Boot equivalents, and preserves all business logic including the hour-adjustment in 0110-GIVING-TIME, the SQLCODE evaluation in 0510-GET-LOGIN, and the full EVALUATE WS-DEPT routing table in 0520-PROCESS-DATA.
patterns_used: Strategy Pattern (CryptVerifyService replaces pluggable CRYPTVE CALL)
Result Object Pattern (GetLoginResult record replaces WS-FLAG-LS working-storage group)
Enum as Domain Model (Department enum replaces 88-level / EVALUATE WS-DEPT)
Global Exception Handler / ControllerAdvice (replaces CICS ABEND handling)
plan.sql_strategy: The single EXEC SQL SELECT ADMIDATE, DEPTID INTO :WS-ADMIDATE, :WS-DEPT FROM EMPLO WHERE EMPID = :WS-USERID END-EXEC is replaced by EmployeeRepository.findByEmpId(String) using a JPQL @Query with TRIM to handle PIC X(8) right-space-padding. SQLCODE 0 maps to Optional.of(employee), SQLCODE 100 (NOT FOUND) maps to Optional.empty(), and SQLCODE OTHER maps to a DataAccessException caught in the service layer, all setting the equivalent WS-FLAG-RETURN value (0, 1, or 2).
plan.call_strategy: The CALL 'CRYPTVE' USING WS-PASSWORD, WS-USERID, WS-ADMIDATE, WS-FLAG-LS is replaced by CryptVerifyService.verify(plainPassword, userId, admiDate, storedHash). Since the CRYPTVE source is not available, the service uses BCryptPasswordEncoder (Spring Security Crypto) as a functionally equivalent password verifier. The VerifyResult record mirrors WS-FLAG-LS (WS-FLAG-RETURN + WS-FLAG-ERROR). The CICS XCTL PROGRAM('SRCHFLI') for department 7 is replaced by returning routingTarget='SRCHFLI' in the LoginResponse, allowing the REST caller to initiate the next step.
